purpose: Research-only three-level access grades with an Esri imagery check. NOT read by the app; the catalog registry (catalog/map_points/AR.json) carries the published status.

levels.verified: managing-agency launch feature (AGFC boating access / NPS river access POI / USFS canoe launch) within the NHD HR named-river limit and imagery pass / pass-ramp-head
levels.access-verified: agency-documented public access, but the coordinate is a recreation-area point, exceeds the NHD HR distance limit, or the imagery did not clearly show a launch at the pin (approximate area)
levels.pending: no agency coordinate, identity unconfirmed, excluded, or imagery not graded

imageryVerdicts.pass: pin at the water's edge / launch
imageryVerdicts.pass-ramp-head: pin at the parking/ramp head with a visible route to water within ~40 m
imageryVerdicts.downgrade: verified candidate whose pin is not at a usable launch; published as access-verified

nhdHR.service: USGS NHD High Resolution HU4 GeoPackages

limitations: Esri tiles carry no capture date; Ozark gravel bars and channels move after floods, and NHD HR geometry can lag the current channel. Tailwater ramps are graded at whatever level the imagery was captured.
